questions.solution:
n = 3
matrix = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
num = 1
top, bottom, left, right = 0, n - 1, 0, n - 1
while top <= bottom and left <= right:
    for j in range(left, right + 1):
        matrix[top][j] = num
        num += 1
    top += 1
    for i in range(top, bottom + 1):
        matrix[i][right] = num
        num += 1
    right -= 1
    for j in range(right, left - 1, -1):
        matrix[bottom][j] = num
        num += 1
    bottom -= 1
    for i in range(bottom, top - 1, -1):
        matrix[i][left] = num
        num += 1
    left += 1
for row in matrix:
    print(row)

questions.description: 用 for 求最大子段和（Kadane）。
questions.code_template:
nums = [-2, 1, -3, 4, -1, 2, 1, -5, 4]
max_sum = nums[0]
cur = 0
for n in nums:
    cur = max(n, cur + n)
    max_sum = max(max_sum, cur)
print(___)
questions.solution:
nums = [-2, 1, -3, 4, -1, 2, 1, -5, 4]
max_sum = nums[0]
cur = 0
for n in nums:
    cur = max(n, cur + n)
    max_sum = max(max_sum, cur)
print(max_sum)

questions.description: 求 1 到 500 的水仙花数。
用 for 实现插入排序。
questions.code_template:
nums = [5, 3, 8, 1]
for i in range(1, len(nums)):
    key = nums[i]
    j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 and nums[j] > key:
        nums[j + 1] = nums[j]
        j -= 1
    nums[j + 1] = key
print(___)
questions.solution:
nums = [5, 3, 8, 1]
for i in range(1, len(nums)):
    key = nums[i]
    j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 and nums[j] > key:
        nums[j + 1] = nums[j]
        j -= 1
    nums[j + 1] = key
print(nums)

questions.description: 用 for 找连续最大乘积（简化）。
questions.code_template:
nums = [2, 3, -2, 4]
max_prod = nums[0]
for i in range(len(nums)):
    prod = 1
    for j in range(i, len(nums)):
        prod *= nums[j]
        max_prod = max(max_prod, prod)
print(___)
questions.solution:
nums = [2, 3, -2, 4]
max_prod = nums[0]
for i in range(len(nums)):
    prod = 1
    for j in range(i, len(nums)):
        prod *= nums[j]
        max_prod = max(max_prod, prod)
print(f"Max product: {max_prod}")

questions.description: 生成数字金字塔（居中）。

questions.solution:

    line = " ".join(str(j) for j in range(1, i + 1))
    print(f"{line:^{n * 2}}")
